show.description:
When a young woman’s pregnancy is revealed, her in-laws humiliate her and attempt to call off the wedding.
But her partner stands by her side, shielding her from shame and choosing love over judgment.
A heartfelt journey of courage, compassion, and the promise of unconditional support.
